m1_length.description: TOTAL effective channel length of the lower cascode vptat generator transistor. Drawn as a series stack of two M1/M1b devices (gates tied, internal net m1_mid), each with l = m1_length/2 (formula m1_seglen), so each one stays inside the PSP103 model's L <= 10u range (min 0.45u each -> total >= 0.9u). Not electrically identical to one long device (~1% on Vref: body effect at the internal node), so it is simulated as drawn. LVS has no MOS series combiner, hence the stack is explicit in the schematic.

m1_width.description: Channel Width of the lower cascode vptat generator transistor

m2_length.description: TOTAL effective channel length of the upper cascode vptat generator transistor. Drawn as a series stack of two M2/M2b devices (gates tied, internal net m2_mid), each with l = m2_length/2 (formula m2_seglen), so each one stays inside the PSP103 model's L <= 10u range (min 0.45u each -> total >= 0.9u). Not electrically identical to one long device (~1% on Vref: body effect at the internal node), so it is simulated as drawn. LVS has no MOS series combiner, hence the stack is explicit in the schematic.

m6m7_length.description: Channel Length of the M6/M7 nmos current mirror pair in the self-biased voltage following current mirror (sbvfcm)

m6m7_width_base.description: Shared unit-cell channel width for the M6/M7 nmos current-mirror pair (sbvfcm) -- actual per-leg width is this * the leg's own integer factor (m6_factor/m7_factor), computed in Python before schematic substitution (never a formula in the netlist). See this file's derived_parameters.width_groups.

m6_factor.description: Integer multiple of m6m7_width_base giving M6's actual channel width (diode-connected mirror leg) -- also the intended unit-cell count for future common-centroid layout.

m7_factor.description: Integer multiple of m6m7_width_base giving M7's actual channel width (mirrored leg) -- together with m6_factor this sets the sbvfcm's current-mirror ratio, a real circuit design freedom, not just a matching artifact.

m8m9_length.description: Channel Length of the M8/M9 nmos cascode pair stacked above M6/M7 in the sbvfcm

m8m9_width_base.description: Shared unit-cell channel width for the M8/M9 nmos cascode pair stacked above M6/M7 -- actual per-leg width is this * the leg's own integer factor (m8_factor/m9_factor). See this file's derived_parameters.width_groups.

m8_factor.description: Integer multiple of m8m9_width_base giving M8's actual channel width. Locked to 1 for now (min=max=1) -- preserves today's exact M8=M9 invariant; widen only as a deliberate later decision once a reason to ratio the cascodes differently is identified.

m9_factor.description: Integer multiple of m8m9_width_base giving M9's actual channel width. Locked to 1 for now, see m8_factor.

startup_cap_mult.description: Instance multiplier (m=) of the startup capacitor C1

w_finger_max.description: Maximum gate width PER FINGER the PSP103 model is valid for (PDK ihp-sg13cmos5l sg13g2_mos{hv,lv}_parm.lib, 'Valid range for model': W up to 10um, HV and LV). w= in the schematic is the TOTAL width of one instance (per finger = w/ng), so each device's ng = ceil(w / w_finger_max); m multiplies whole instances.

islands._comment: Self-biased voltage-following current mirror pair (m6_factor/m7_factor, shared m6m7_length) -- the real validation target for Fase 1 placement.

layout._comment: Magic floorplan flow input (mh-analog-designer: gen_layout --stage spec -> sim/<variation>/layout/layout_spec.json). Devices are generated bare (no own guard ring, no metal2 risers); each group below gets its own guard ring, tied to its members' bulk net.

M3._comment: 50 um in 5 um fingers (the M10/M11 unit: exact 10:1 mirror by unit count), squarest ng x m. The schematic's 5 x 10 um fingers is a 53 um row.

groups._comment: Self-cascode vptat generator: M1/M1b and M2/M2b are the two halves of each series stack (identical segments). Mirroring each stack across the axis puts M1 and M2 on a common centroid, which is what sets vptat.

sbvfcm current mirror, ratio m6_factor:m7_factor (20:1 by default) of the shared m6m7 unit: a common-centroid matrix of unit instances (M6/M7 share no source/drain, so no shared diffusion); the pattern is automatic (M7 in the centre), `rows` in array overrides it.
Cascode pair stacked over M6/M7 (M8=M9 while m8_factor=m9_factor).
PMOS mirror on pbias (shared pbias_length): M10 diode + M11 mirror each other, the wide M3 sits on the axis.
Startup NMOS; C1 (cap_cmomf, no bulk) stays outside any ring.
